units.source_text: ……柏木总算用平时蹲坐的动作，慢悠悠地侧着身子坐在我劝坐的薄坐垫上。

en.t: ...Kashiwagi finally sat down on the thin cushion I had offered him, slowly turning his body sideways in his usual crouching motion.

units.source_text: 他抬起头来扫视了房间一圈。

en.t: He lifted his head and looked around the room.

units.source_text: 雨声像一块厚厚的垂帝机户外封闭起来。

en.t: The sound of the rain shut off the outside world like a thick hanging curtain.

units.source_text: 溅在窗外窄廊上的雨点，偶然反弹在拉门上。

en.t: Raindrops splashing onto the narrow veranda outside the window would occasionally bounce back against the sliding door.
